name: TT9 Keyboard
tagline: A classic T9 keypad keyboard like old Nokia phones
description:
TT9 brings back the T9 predictive text keypad from classic Nokia phones, letting you type by pressing number keys instead of a full keyboard. It's great if you miss the old-school typing feel, want a faster one-handed option, or just enjoy a bit of nostalgia.

The app is actively maintained and open source, with support for multiple languages and layouts.
